item.title: Impact Day Saturday for a threat of storms
item.description: An Impact Day is in effect for Saturday as a line of showers and storms looks to move through our area. The line looks to move through during the early afternoon and gradually weaken as it moves east through the evening. Still, threats of damaging wind gusts, hail and heavy rainfall are in the forecast [...]
